description.en: Planned animal asset: broad primitive bat wings with claws retained on all wing digits.
description.zh: 规划中的动物资产：所有翼指保留爪的宽早期蝙蝠翼。

scientific_scope.en: Living reconstruction proposal, not a scanned specimen. A named museum or primary reference supports identity and specified evidence. The proposed whole form and low-poly distinction still require the listed production gate.
scientific_scope.zh: 活体复原方案，并非扫描标本。具名博物馆或一手资料支持身份及指定证据。拟议整体形态与低多边形差异仍须通过所列制作关卡。

distinctness.en: Shape criterion: broad primitive bat wings with claws retained on all wing digits. Retain this anatomical combination when compared with nearby forms; a name, scale or pose change alone does not qualify.
distinctness.zh: 形态判据：所有翼指保留爪的宽早期蝙蝠翼。须与相近形态对照保留这一结构组合；仅改名称、尺寸或姿态不成立。

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly brief: block broad primitive bat wings with claws retained on all wing digits with a small number of readable masses; preserve negative spaces and joint transitions. Use a restrained neutral palette; simplify surface texture only after the silhouette reads. Validate the diagnostic feature before detailed geometry.
modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形说明：用少量清晰体块组织所有翼指保留爪的宽早期蝙蝠翼；保留负空间与关节过渡。采用克制的中性色；轮廓成立后再简化表面纹理。精细几何制作前须核实鉴别特征。

uncertainty: Skin, color and unpreserved soft tissues are not established by this inventory. Choose a species and specimen before final anatomy approval.

reference_notes.en: Named taxon or specimen checked in VT-ONYCHONYCTERIS. Use the source within its stated limits; a distinct low-poly silhouette and all soft tissues still need review.
reference_notes.zh: 已在 VT-ONYCHONYCTERIS 核实具名分类单元或标本。须遵守来源的证据范围；独立的低多边形轮廓及软组织仍待审核。

sources.title: Hall of Advanced Mammals
sources.supports: Group-level Cenozoic mammal diversity and exhibit context; does not validate every genus in the planning list.

sources.title: Researchers Find Bats Evolved Ability To Fly Before Echolocation
sources.supports: Onychonycteris finneyi: Eocene, claws on all five fingers, short broad wings, relatively long hind limbs. Echolocation inference is not needed for the asset.
